rationale: The benchmark candidate requires structured delivery because it spans six canonical owners, multiple source and derived paths, three hosts, runtime behavior, product semantics, and cross-host coordination. Compact delivery is not eligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced. Verified change is also ineligible because ownership is not singular and deterministic propagation is false.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement only.
canonical_owner_count=6, so the work is cross-owner rather than narrowly owned.
source_path_count=8 and derived_path_count=8 indicate a multi-path change surface.
Impacts include product_semantics=true, runtime=true, and cross_host=true.
The task covers twelve critical governance scenarios across three hosts with version-bound observation and acceptance.
deterministic_propagation=false, which disqualifies verified_change when derived paths exist.
No completed Brownfield analysis is supplied.
No stored quick_task context is supplied, so compact_delivery requirements are not met.
Any impact broader than the supplied facts requires fail-closed escalation.
